title: ask.json
description: Common settings for ask and ask-tui. Files are layered (global ~/.config/ask/, --config or $ASK_CONFIG, the project's ask.json and .ask/, $ASK_CONFIG_CONTENT, ASK_* variables, flags); null removes a lower layer's value and an empty string means "not set". Strings may use {env:NAME}.

endpoint.description: Where requests go. An untrusted project cannot set this; see ask /trust. A layer that changes url without apiKey does not inherit a lower layer's key.

url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1. Defaults to OPENAI_BASE_URL.

apiKey.description: API key. Prefer "{env:NAME}" to keep it out of the file. Defaults to OPENAI_API_KEY.

organization.description: OpenAI organization ID. Defaults to OPENAI_ORG_ID.

project.description: OpenAI project ID. Defaults to OPENAI_PROJECT_ID.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; omitted from requests unless set.

maxTokens.description: Cap on the answer length, in tokens.

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds (also ASK_TIMEOUT, --timeout). Default 120.

instructions.description: Extra instruction files or globs, relative to this file (~/ allowed in your own config), added after AGENTS.md. Lists from layers are joined; null clears earlier ones.
